description: This file defines the ScreenSlideActivity class, which demonstrates the use of ViewPager for screen-slide animations between multiple fragments in an Android application. It manages paging through wizard steps, menu options for navigation, and the associated adapter for fragment management.

classes.name: ScreenSlideActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating ViewPager for screen slide transitions between fragments, with menu navigation for next, previous, and finish actions.

classes.name: ScreenSlidePagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter providing fragments to the ViewPager, managing the sequence of wizard steps.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager and its adapter, and defines page change behavior.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and dynamically adds 'next' or 'finish' actions based on the current page.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation actions, including up navigation, previous, and next.
